literal.prompt: Какая научная станция расположена непосредственно на географическом Южном полюсе?

literalGroups.primaryGround: USAP explicitly identifies Amundsen-Scott at the Earth axis and describes the South Pole station; BAS gives the South Pole at 90°S and Vostok at 79°S; IPEV locates Concordia at 75°06′S on Dome C. The wording asks which station is directly at the geographic pole, uniquely selecting Amundsen-Scott among the four stations.
literalGroups.locator: USAP lines 91-104; BAS factsheet lines 49-51; IPEV lines 83-90.

literalGroups.literal: Это станция Амундсен — Скотт. Она находится непосредственно у географического Южного полюса на дрейфующем антарктическом ледяном щите.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The USAP page calls the facility Amundsen-Scott South Pole Station, describes it at the Earth axis, and says it sits on a shifting continental ice sheet; both sentences identify the keyed station and add no unsupported naming-history claim.
literalGroups.locator: USAP lines 91-104: Amundsen-Scott station at the Earth axis/South Pole; lines 104,111: shifting continental ice sheet.

literalGroups.literal: Восток — высокогорная станция на внутреннем плато; там зафиксирована рекордно низкая температура у поверхности Земли.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Personally read the complete retained COMNAP document. At L73, the page first states that interior-plateau conditions are colder, then identifies Vostok as a high plateau research station holding the record for the lowest surface temperature ever recorded. Together with BAS L50 placing Vostok at 79°S,107°E, this supports the unchanged note and distinguishes it from the station at 90°S.
literalGroups.locator: Retained COMNAP second document in original combined response, L73: interior-plateau context, Vostok high plateau station and lowest-ever surface temperature; BAS factsheet L50 places Vostok at 79°S,107°E.

literalGroups.literal: Мак-Мердо расположена на острове Росса у побережья Антарктиды.
literalGroups.primaryGround: GVP states Erebus overlooks the McMurdo research station on Ross Island (L80,L116), grounding the option-specific location and distinguishing it from the South Pole.

literalGroups.literal: Станция находится на дрейфующем континентальном ледяном щите на высоте 2 835 м.
literalGroups.primaryGround: USAP states the station sits at the Earth axis on a shifting continental ice sheet (L104) and gives its elevation as 2,835 m (L111); elevation is a concrete additional fact beyond the prompt/key.

literalGroups.literal: Конкордия — совместная французско-итальянская станция на высоком антарктическом плато.
literalGroups.primaryGround: IPEV identifies Concordia as French-Italian (L52), built at Dome C/inland (L54-L55,L83-L90), with 3,233 m elevation (L63); this supports the note’s partnership and high-plateau description.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: Грамматика корректна; Восто́к — правдоподобная антарктическая станция. Она на внутреннем плато в 79°S, тогда как ключевая станция стоит на 90°S, поэтому ключ уникален. Заметка верна и полезно отличает вариант рекордной температурой и высокогорным положением.
